values: A classical Wu-manifold answer to a free-rank question; Alec Kriebel; version 1.0; preprint date 2026-10-16; problem 30001522; https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/788. The fixed simply connected Wu manifold answers Hanke's printed 2010 actual-free rank question: free toral and free 2-ranks zero, free p-rank one for every odd prime; a classical explanatory note with a proof covering arbitrary continuous actions. Extensive AI use; unrefereed, no external human peer review or formal proof verification. Classical inputs credited. Earlier CWY–Mundet examples already have actual free cyclic actions for every odd prime and no nontrivial continuous circle action; their nonabelian fundamental groups exclude them from this target. Priority remains unresolved; no firstness, certified novelty or current worldwide-open certification. Deposit includes PDF and source/verification archive.
